headline: Asian Currencies Strengthen as US Dollar Declines
summary: Asian currencies rose against the US dollar as the greenback weakened following US election developments.
why: Currency markets are highly sensitive to US political outcomes and the resulting impact on Federal Reserve policy expectations.

impacts.name: US Dollar Index
impacts.why: The US dollar is the primary counter-currency in global FX markets.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Market participants often adjust positions in response to political shifts, leading to volatility in the US dollar and corresponding movements in regional currencies.
